Filter notes

Corporate client, Division, Service, Move type
Keep only services that match. Most rows have no division.
Service provider is
Who counts as the provider: the consultant on the file, or the user assigned to each action.
Service provider, Resource role
Keep only matching actions, so a file may be partly counted.
Date range
Services must start by the end date. In Front load, the start date only affects closed services. In Monthly, actions must be worked in the range.
Report type
Group by provider or by client. TE detail adds one row per service.
Hours to report
Front load counts all hours on in-scope services, except cancelled actions. Monthly counts only actions worked in the range.
Services included
Closed and on-hold services are left out unless ticked.

Field and value notes

Source
FactWorkload is a replica of Service Engine's udv_workload_view_34: same columns and same rows.
Workload Hours
Sum of Resource Time. This is the estimate on the action template, not time recorded.
0.00 hours
Usually means the action template has no time set.
# of Services
Different services: file + service name + workflow name.
# Files, Workload for N Files
Different file numbers. A file with 3 services counts once.
Actions
Workflow steps counted. Cancelled actions never count.
TE detail rows
One row per service, so a file can appear several times.
Auth/Srvc Date
Earliest action initiated date on the service.
Service Status
Closed means Cancelled, Financially Closed or Service Complete. On Hold is separate. Anything else is open.
Status Date
When the service reached its current status.
FTE
Hours ÷ 154 per month.
(Unassigned)
No consultant or assigned user on the action.
